about: Hand-labelled retrieval benchmark for candidate evidence (Phase 2 RAG). Two resumes of one candidate with overlapping and conflicting experience (the same employer, Acme, under different titles), untagged manual facts, a fact a person tagged to one resume, and jobs pinned in every way a job can be (USER, SETUP, ACTIVE, AUTO). `relevant` lists the facts a reviewer expects in the job's evidence pack; `forbidden` lists facts that must never appear (another resume's). Facts are named by label and resolved to Evidence ids at run time.

concepts._about: A controlled stand-in for an embedding model in the hybrid evaluation: words in one group share a meaning. It is synthetic and only shows that the fusion uses meaning when a model supplies it; real-model quality is measured by scripts/rag_eval.py against a configured model.
